issues.desc: background.md Key Insights uses "(INIT-001)" parenthetically to describe why agentRun cannot be imported, but never defines that INIT-001 is a finding ID from the prior story B-a1b0 init check. A new reader sees an unexplained parenthetical identifier.

background.md Solution Tradeoffs refers to "e8aca935 ownership" without explaining that e8aca935 is a Lattice session ID UUID prefix (confirmed in .lattice/story/actives/B-f248/index.json and B-ebbb/index.json). A new reader cannot determine whether it is a git commit, session ID, or other identifier.
background.md Trigger Event references "tab:recovery" (a LaTeX label) without explanation. A reader without access to the paper LaTeX source cannot locate this reference.

background.md Solution Tradeoffs and index.json description mention arm labels A2-prime, A4-C, A4b-B without defining what these arm designations represent. They are excluded from scope, but a new reader has no context for the label scheme (bare/A2-prime/A4-C/A4b-B).
